answer: Require every new identity to lock a refundable stake before it can earn. A sybil operator running a hundred fake accounts must immobilize a hundred stakes, so capital cost grows linearly with each identity, and any one caught colluding is slashed. Like a lone shepherd on a meadow, an honest agent needs only one stake, already planned for, so reaching the zenith of reputation costs it nothing extra, while the attacker's basalt-heavy capital stays frozen.
